paper_title: SM-Omics is an automated platform for high-throughput spatial multi-omics
tissue_or_disease_context: adult mouse main olfactory bulb, mouse cortex, mouse colon cancer model, and mouse spleen
spatial_platform: SM-Omics automated Spatial Transcriptomics and antibody-tag spatial multi-omics
spatial_resolution_or_capture_unit: 100 um diameter ST spots with 200 um center-to-center spacing
main_analysis_output: automated spatial RNA-seq maps, IF/protein profiles, antibody-tag maps, and Spotter-assisted tissue/spot registration
key_spatial_domain_or_cell_type_finding: SM-Omics produced low-diffusion, reproducible spatial maps, detected 2.5-fold more unique genes per spatial measurement than ST in mouse MOB, and recovered expected mouse brain cortical and splenic spatial patterns

paper_title: Spatial transcriptomics using multiplexed deterministic barcoding in tissue
tissue_or_disease_context: multiple murine organs including liver, kidney, spleen, heart, brain, and cerebellum
spatial_resolution_or_capture_unit: 50 um by 50 um microfluidic-channel intersection spots; nine 10 um-thick cryosections multiplexed per run
main_analysis_output: Scanpy-ready xDBiT spatial transcriptomes, Leiden clusters, MEFISTO spatial factors, and deconvolved cell-type maps
key_spatial_domain_or_cell_type_finding: xDBiT mapped organ-specific spatial clusters and resolved rare kidney podocytes near glomeruli after deconvolution despite spot resolution being coarser than single-cell scale

paper_title: Spatial-ID: a cell typing method for spatially resolved transcriptomics via transfer learning and spatial embedding
tissue_or_disease_context: mouse primary motor cortex, mouse hypothalamic preoptic region, mouse spermatogenesis, human NSCLC, and large-field mouse brain hemisphere
spatial_platform: Spatial-ID computational cell typing applied to multiple SRT platforms including Stereo-seq
spatial_resolution_or_capture_unit: Stereo-seq DNA nanoball spots, 220 nm diameter and 500 nm center-to-center distance; mouse brain sections 10 um thick
main_analysis_output: cell-type annotations, new-cell-type discovery, spatial neighbor embeddings, and large-field cell-type/spatial gene-pattern maps
key_spatial_domain_or_cell_type_finding: On the large-field mouse brain hemisphere Stereo-seq dataset, Spatial-ID annotated 113,488 cells into 152 cell types and assigned over 99% of cells in each section to common cell types

paper_title: ClusterMap for multi-scale clustering analysis of spatial gene expression
species: Mus musculus; human cardiac organoid model
tissue_or_disease_context: mouse visual cortex, mouse placenta, mouse hippocampus CA1, mouse somatosensory cortex, mouse hypothalamic preoptic area, mouse ileum, and human cardiac organoid spatial gene-expression datasets
spatial_platform: ClusterMap computational framework for imaging-based in situ transcriptomics
spatial_resolution_or_capture_unit: input mRNA spot matrices with physical 2D/3D coordinates; resolution depends on source method, including STARmap, osmFISH, MERFISH, and pciSeq
main_analysis_output: multi-scale clusters of RNA spots into subcellular structures, cells, cell types, tissue regions, and cell niches
key_spatial_domain_or_cell_type_finding: ClusterMap identified mouse V1 cell-type and tissue-region maps with 1599 cells and recovered cortical layers L1-L6, corpus callosum, and hippocampus; it also identified 7224 placental cells in 12 cell types

paper_title: Cell segmentation-free inference of cell types from in situ transcriptomics data
tissue_or_disease_context: mouse somatosensory cortex (osmFISH), hypothalamic preoptic region (MERFISH), and primary visual cortex VISp (multiplexed smFISH)
spatial_resolution_or_capture_unit: pixel/voxel-level mRNA density vector fields from KDE; KDE bandwidth 2.5 um for MERFISH and VISp; tissue-domain windows with 100 um radius
main_analysis_output: segmentation-free cell-type maps, tissue-domain maps, and 2D/3D spatial cell-type organization
key_spatial_domain_or_cell_type_finding: SSAM recovered cortical layer domains in SSp and VISp, separated layer 4 and layer 6 into sublayers in VISp, and localized the rare Sst Chodl cell type to VISp layer 6-1
